admission.justification: The exception is the Order drawing accent, not the complete SprintGraphView word/mark palette or a second task-stage/activity/count owner. The alternatives are documented previous/rule-question choices, not invented design-discussion history.

alternatives.option: Choose Order border, ID and meta styling from the native started stage independently of host activity; keep all task words and marks common, and keep readiness separate from stage or permission.
alternatives.reason: D305 restores the lost golden border. The 2026-10-17T02:27:47+02:00 Architect ruling explicitly narrows the older F1 common-tone rule for the Order drawing started accent only.

alternatives.option: Retain the older F1 rule that every Order graph accent must follow the shared activity-aware task-status tone.
alternatives.reason: The explicit D305 successor ruling restores the started work accent even for paused or unknown activity and calls this a meaning replacement, not preservation.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A new developer ruling withdraws the started accent exception and again requires those graph accents to match activity-aware status tones.
